answer: Each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 660 aliases need 660 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The wharf test is the live device, the vertex test is the locked stake, and the pulse test is the graded history no template can fake.
